formula: ema(ts_pct(close, 5) * safe_div(numerator=volume, denominator=ts_max(volume, 20)) * (safe_div(numerator=high - low, denominator=ts_quantile(high - low, 20, 0.5)) - 1), 5)
rationale: Preserves the core regime-dependent trend-volume interaction from parent. Replaces binary high_vol indicator with continuous volatility deviation to retain more information, and applies a short EMA smoothing to reduce noise and improve rank stability.
filter: volume > 0 AND not is_suspend AND close < high_limit AND close > low_limit
